description: Adversarial fixtures for retrieval ranking and claim verification. Passages and expected verdicts are AUTHORITATIVE FIXTURES — never a model's output. Licence values come from the projects' published terms (Redis BSD-3, Memcached Apache 2.0); the wrong values in the claim cases are the audited failure modes.
mode_note: Deterministic functions only: app.evidence.select and app.claim_check.verify. No model, no network, no vector store — so this measures ranking and classification behaviour, not real-world truth.

retrieval_cases.note: The answering passage has a LOWER similarity than a topical distractor.
retrieval_cases.question: What licence is Redis distributed under?

passages.text: Redis is a popular in-memory data store used as a cache and for queues.
Redis is distributed under the BSD-3 licence.
